Purpose: Offline fixed-state renderer timing for the adjacent-column signed 20.12 wall-boundary recurrence versus direct per-column offset evaluation.
RenderMode: Fixed IWAD game state and camera; geometry, actors, weapon and HUD timed serially; no terminal, audio, input, or simulation timing.
Interpretation: E1M1 candidate geometry median is slower; E1M2 is effectively flat. No repeatable speedup was demonstrated. Full-frame hashes match between variants within each map. The recurrence should not be retained as a performance optimization.
Caveats: Two runs per variant per map and 50 frame samples per variant; machine scheduling and load are uncontrolled. Serial fixed-state timings are not concurrent worker, live host, display pacing, or user-perceived performance.
